mapper.select: select ab.*, m.mname from admin_board ab join member m on ab.mno = m.mno where ab.abcategory = 'NOTICE' order by ab.abno desc
select ab.*, m.mname from admin_board ab join member m on ab.mno = m.mno where ab.abcategory = 'EVENT' order by ab.abno desc
select ab.*, m.mname from admin_board ab join member m on ab.mno = m.mno where ab.abno = #{abno}
mapper.insert: insert into admin_board(abno, abtitle, abcontent, abfiles, abdate, abcategory, mno) values(AB_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{abtitle}, #{abcontent}, #{abfiles, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{abcategory}, #{mno})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT INNER_LIST.*, ROWNUM AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT A.ABNO, A.ABTITLE, A.ABCONTENT, A.ABFILES, A.ABDATE, A.ABHIT, A.ABCATEGORY, A.MNO, (SELECT MNAME FROM MEMBER WHERE MNO = A.MNO) AS MNAME FROM ADMIN_BOARD A LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON A.MNO = M.MNO WHERE TRIM(A.ABCATEGORY) = 'EVENT' ORDER BY A.ABNO DESC ) INNER_LIST ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ADMIN_BOARD WHERE ABCATEGORY = 'EVENT'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT INNER_LIST.*, ROWNUM AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT A.ABNO, A.ABTITLE, A.ABCONTENT, A.ABFILES, A.ABDATE, A.ABHIT, A.ABCATEGORY, A.MNO, M.MNAME FROM ADMIN_BOARD A LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON A.MNO = M.MNO WHERE TRIM(A.ABCATEGORY) = 'NOTICE' ORDER BY A.ABNO DESC ) INNER_LIST ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ADMIN_BOARD WHERE TRIM(ABCATEGORY) = 'NOTICE'
